name: playwrightautomation
description: Revance Loyalty Playwright Test automation (welcome + complete profile)

scripts.test:debug: cross-env TEST_ENV=qa HEADED=true SLOW_MO=50 playwright test --project=chromium
scripts.test:completeprofile: cross-env TEST_ENV=qa HEADLESS=true playwright test --project=chromium tests/ui/completeprofile.spec.ts
scripts.test:completeprofile:headed: cross-env TEST_ENV=qa HEADED=true playwright test --project=chromium tests/ui/completeprofile.spec.ts
scripts.test:pw:completeprofile: cross-env TEST_ENV=qa HEADLESS=true playwright test --project=chromium tests/ui/completeprofile.spec.ts
scripts.test:pw:completeprofile:headed: cross-env TEST_ENV=qa HEADED=true playwright test --project=chromium tests/ui/completeprofile.spec.ts
scripts.test:chromium: cross-env BROWSER=chromium TEST_ENV=qa HEADLESS=true playwright test --project=chromium
scripts.test:firefox: cross-env BROWSER=firefox TEST_ENV=qa HEADLESS=true playwright test --project=firefox
scripts.test:webkit: cross-env BROWSER=webkit TEST_ENV=qa HEADLESS=true playwright test --project=webkit
scripts.allure:generate: node scripts/allure-prepare-metadata.js && node ./node_modules/allure/cli.js generate --config allurerc.cjs reports/allure-results
